items.fullText: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA French companies are putting NVIDIA infrastructure and open models to work across all industries, from satellites in orbit to cosmetics in corner stores. October 12, 2026 by Nat Ives 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign AI Infrastructure France-based companies are expanding agentic infrastructure on NVIDIA technology. Bull is extending its European AI server production to NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ultra NVL72 systems, planned for 2028, with trays produced in Europe and rack integration at its Angers factory — inaugurated Friday, Oct. 2. Altair-1, the first satellite in a $1 billion, 50-satellite constellation with on-board autonomous capabilities, launched this month and has successfully reached orbit. Integrated by Loft Orbital and built in Abu Dhabi by Orbitworks , a joint venture between Loft Orbital and Marlan Space , the satellite is flying NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge modules, running Mistral’s models, for real-time Earth observation and autonomous operations in orbit. Open Models NVIDIA Nemotron open models are in production across French organizations that require sovereign, trustworthy data. LINAGORA and Docaposte have secured the CANUT framework agreement , making Twake.ai, built on NVIDIA Nemotron, the sole referenced sovereign digital workplace for more than 2,500 French public organizations. items.t: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
items.d: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?
items.fullText: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken (buy me a drink sometime, and I’ll give you my rant). But could AI actually make things better? Honeyjar , which will be attending this week’s TechCrunch Disrupt as part of the Startup Battlefield 200 , wants to use AI to make the expertise and judgment of the best PR pros available to everyone, including founders who have no idea where to start. The startup’s founders, CEO Michelle Masek and CCO Nadia Jamshidi, certainly fit the bill when it comes to PR expertise. They’ve both spent decades in the field, doing in-house communications and working at agencies. Masek recently served as senior vice president of marketing and communications for Ev Williams’ venture firm, Obvious Ventures . As Masek described the challenges involved in “helping with the why and when of comms and marketing for 110 portfolio companies” (the startups her firm had invested in), I flashed back to my own brief stint leading marketing at an early-stage VC firm , where founders were constantly asking for help getting into TechCrunch. So I wasn’t surprised that Masek found herself asking, “Is there a way to scale the senior-level expertise into AI [in a way] that actually helps users do the work of comms in the proactive and skilled way that we do?” Honeyjar is her answer to that question. It automates processes like writing announcements, finding the best journalists to pitch, and identifying the most promising speaking opportunities. But Jamshidi told me in a follow-up email that Honeyjar’s vision goes beyond getting press coverage and beyond specific AI tools. “Honeyjar can find reporters, build media lists, scan news and social, track coverage, and surface opportunities,” she said. “Those capabilities are important, but they’re just one piece of what we’re building. Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
items.d: Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 2:14 PM PDT · October 11, 2026 Image Credits: Brian Heater / TechCrunch Anthony Ha Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success? Apple will announce a new smart home hub on Tuesday called the HomeView, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman . Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product , but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date. Gurman described the HomeView as a Siri-powered device with a display and an A18 chip, allowing customers to control their other smart home devices. The HomeView will reportedly be available in two models — one designed for countertops and the other to be mounted on walls. This would be Apple’s most serious bet on the smart home to date, after it failed to get much traction for its HomeKit software framework or its HomePod smart speaker. Gurman reports that on Tuesday, Apple will also be unveiling updated versions of two other home devices, namely the Apple TV set-top box and the HomePod mini. Earlier this week, he said that Apple plans to announce a partnership with LG to create a smart lock, a thermostat, and a doorbell. items.fullText: 판타지의 경계를 확장하다: 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지가 도쿄게임쇼 2026에서 펼치는 캐릭터 IP와 리테일의 미래 2026/09/23 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 9월 17일부터 20일까지 일본 지바현 마쿠하리 멧세(Makuhari Messe)에서 열린 도쿄게임쇼 2026(Tokyo Game Show 2026, TGS). 글로벌 게임 기업 엔씨 부스는 게임 속 캐릭터를 눈앞에서 만나는 듯한 경험을 하려는 관람객들의 발길이 이어졌다. 그 중심에는 게임의 세계관을 화면 밖으로 확장한 삼성전자의 무안경 3D 디스플레이 ‘스페이셜 사이니지(Spatial Signage)’가 있었다. 이번 행사에서 엔씨가 선보인 ‘아스트라에 오라티오(Astrae Oratio)’는 마법이 일상에 스며든 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 신전기 서브컬처 RPG다. 삼성 스페이셜 사이니지는 독자적인 ‘3D 플레이트(3D Plate)’ 기술을 적용해 별도의 3D 안경 없이도 콘텐츠에 생생한 입체감을 선사하며, 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 오프라인 전시 공간으로 확장했다. 팬덤 경험 확장… 캐릭터와의 만남을 현실 공간으로 게임 퍼블리셔와 콘텐츠 IP(Intellectual Property, 지식재산권) 보유 기업에게 오프라인 공간은 디지털 콘텐츠를 현실로 가져오는 중요한 접점이다. 엔씨는 도쿄게임쇼에서 85형과 32형 스페이셜 사이니지를 부스 입구와 대기 공간 등에 배치해 관람객이 이동하는 과정에서도 게임 속 캐릭터와 세계관을 자연스럽게 경험하도록 했다. 부스 입구에는 85형 스페이셜 사이니지로 ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 게임의 주요 배경인 ‘특구청’ 건물 내 엘리베이터를 재현했다. 대형 디스플레이를 통해 캐릭터를 실제 사람과 가까운 크기로 표현해, 마치 게임 속 등장인물들이 현실 세계에 인사를 건네는 듯한 장면을 연출했다. ▲ ‘아스트라에 오라티오’ 부스 입구에 설치한 85형 스페이셜 사이니지는 게임 속 다양한 캐릭터가 눈 앞으로 다가오는 듯한 연출로 관람객의 이목을 끌었다. 엔씨 아스트라에 오라티오 사업실 이용수 실장은 “관람객들이 부스에 들어서는 순간부터 실제 크기의 캐릭터와 마주하고 게임 세계에 몰입하길 바랐다”면서 “서브컬처 장르에서는 캐릭터의 생동감과 현실감이 특히 중요한데, 스페이셜 사이니지가 이런 특성을 관람객에게 효과적으로 전달할 수 있다고 판단했다”고 말했다. 현장을 찾은 관람객들은 스페이셜 사이니지가 구현한 캐릭터의 크기와 입체감에 주목했다. 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코(Kawaii CoCo) 씨는 “캐릭터가 실제로 움직이며 상호작용하는 것처럼 생생하게 느껴졌다”며 “일반 디스플레이보다 훨씬 눈에 띄고 소셜미디어에서도 근사하게 보일 것 같아, 이 장면을 촬영해 제 구독자들에게 소개하고 싶다”고 말했다. ▲ 콘텐츠 크리에이터 카와이 코코 씨는 캐릭터의 움직임이 스페이셜 사이니지를 통해 생동감 있게 전달되어 아스트라에 오라티오 부스로 눈길이 갔다고 말했다. 스페이셜 사이니지는 52mm 1 의 얇은 두께에도 불구하고 마치 화면 뒤에 별도의 공간이 있는 듯한 깊이감을 구현한 것이 특징이다. 이러한 경험은 대중에게 게임과 캐릭터의 첫인상을 전달하는 데도 효과적으로 활용될 수 있다. 관람객 다니엘 아세로(Daniel Acero) 씨는 “처음 봤을 때 스크린 화면인 줄 전혀 몰랐고, 투명한 설치물이라고 생각했다”면서 “마치 화면 뒤에 실제 공간이 있는 것처럼 깊이감이 느껴져서 놀라웠고, 이러한 방식으로 게임 캐릭터를 소개하면 게임에 대한 관심을 높이고 캐릭터의 개성을 효과적으로 전달할 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 관람객 동선과 대기 공간에는 32형 스페이셜 사이니지가 설치돼 부스 전반으로 캐릭터 경험을 확장했다. 32형 제품은 49.4mm의 얇은 두께로 좁은 공간에도 유연하게 설치가 가능해, 게임 체험을 기다리는 관람객을 대상으로 캐릭터와 세계관에 대한 몰입도를 유지했다. 관람객 토마스 포르티에(Tomas items.fullText: At AI Day Singapore, NVIDIA and Partners Showcase AI Advancements Across Southeast Asia September 22, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA AI Day Singapore , which takes place Sept. 22-23 at the Raffles City Convention Centre, is offering attendees opportunities to explore the hands-on training, expert-led sessions and advanced tools to accelerate their work in AI and high-performance computing. At the event, NVIDIA and its partners are showcasing breakthrough AI advancements across the Southeast Asia region at large. Read more about these announcements below. NVIDIA Accelerates Public Sector AI from Pilot to Production in Southeast Asia 🔗 AI is becoming a matter of national strategy, with governments looking to move from pilots to production and deliver impact at scale, while building trusted AI capabilities that reflect local languages, cultures, priorities and economic needs. NVIDIA is working to enable all nations to be AI nations — providing the technology, infrastructure, ecosystem and expertise needed to make this possible. To accelerate this transition across Southeast Asia, NVIDIA is helping nations move AI from experimentation to production-scale deployment through open models, developer tools and a broad partner ecosystem. Together, NVIDIA and its partners are focusing on four key areas: Enhancing government operations and service delivery. Developing accessible AI-powered citizen services, and empowering local businesses. Strengthening critical infrastructure and public safety. Supporting startups, developers and researchers to strengthen national AI capabilities and innovation in each country. Singapore’s HTX (Home Team Science and Technology Agency) is embarking on research using the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni models to advance AI for public safety.
